description: The Claude Code spend on account `account` outside the Chat since `since_ms` (tmux windows and any other Claude Code on this computer), as tokens by model (`input`, `output`, `cache_read`, `cache_write`, `messages`), from Claude Code's own transcripts. A session tmux ran in a pane counts for that pane's account at each reply's time (or, on ~/.claude, the account global then); any other session counts for the account that was global when it replied (`global_history`), and `attributed` says how many replies were counted that way. Each reply counts once, by message and request id, wherever its transcript was copied. Read when asked and kept five minutes (`as_of_ms`). `global` names the account global now. Token counts only; never a token. Errors are one JSON object `{code, message}`: `unknown_account`.

account.description: An account id, or `global` for the account global now.

since_ms.description: Count replies from this time on (milliseconds since the epoch), e.g. the account's week start: its `week.resets_at_ms` minus seven days.

ModelSpend.description: The tokens of one model's replies, from Claude Code's transcripts.

cache_read.description: Input tokens read from the prompt cache.

cache_write.description: Input tokens written to the prompt cache.

input.description: Input tokens not read from the cache.

model.description: The model's id as Claude Code recorded it, e.g. `claude-opus-4-5`.

response_schema.description: An account's Claude Code spend outside the Chat (`tmux::usage::claude_outside`).

account.description: The account (the one global now when `global` was asked).

as_of_ms.description: When Claude Code's transcripts were read (at most five minutes ago).

attributed.description: Replies of sessions tmux never ran, counted here because this account was global when they were written.

by_model.description: The spend by model, by model id.

since_ms.description: Replies from this time on are counted.

response_schema.title: OutsideSpend
